about: Curated design directions. A starting point chosen by fit to the product, audience, and feeling; the project's own tokens and brand always win. Every palette is tested for WCAG contrast in light and dark. Fonts are free on Google Fonts. 'study' lists products to learn from, not to copy.

directions.name: Precise tool
directions.fits: developer tool devtool saas productivity issue tracker project management ide terminal command palette api platform b2b software startup engineering cli deploy hosting infrastructure
directions.feel: precise fast focused technical modern sharp
directions.shadow: none; 1px borders and subtle surface steps
directions.imagery: product UI itself, no stock photos; crisp icons at 16px
directions.signature: a keyboard-first command bar and visible shortcuts
directions.avoid: gradient blobs, oversized hero illustrations, rounded bubbly cards

directions.name: Calm workspace
directions.fits: notes note taking docs writing journal personal tasks todo knowledge base wiki reading list planner habit second brain
directions.feel: calm quiet thoughtful warm focused minimal
directions.imagery: almost none; let content and type carry it
directions.signature: a serif title on a paper-tone page that makes writing feel calm
directions.avoid: bright saturated accents, badges everywhere, dense toolbars

directions.name: Fintech trust
directions.fits: bank banking finance fintech payments wallet accounting bookkeeping invoicing payroll budgeting expense tax insurance lending loan investing investment investor stock brokerage money crypto exchange
directions.feel: trustworthy secure clear serious precise reassuring
directions.shadow: subtle, used for cards that hold money
directions.motion: minimal; confirm actions clearly, never animate numbers distractingly
directions.imagery: clean charts and real UI, no handshake stock photos
directions.signature: tabular figures and a calm, exact way of showing amounts and status
directions.avoid: playful illustrations, neon, ambiguous red/green without labels

directions.name: Care and clinical
directions.fits: health healthcare clinic hospital medical patient doctor appointment pharmacy telehealth therapy mental health dental care senior elderly accessibility
directions.feel: reassuring clear gentle accessible human trustworthy
directions.imagery: real people and plain diagrams; no gore, no sterile stock
directions.signature: very large, readable type and one clear next step per screen
directions.avoid: small text, jargon, red for anything that is not a real alarm
directions.study: NHS digital service manual, One Medical

directions.name: Public service
directions.fits: government civic public service council city permit tax filing benefits voting form application registration official utility
directions.imagery: none or functional only
directions.signature: one question per page and bold, plain headings that anyone understands
directions.avoid: decoration, marketing tone, hidden help, tiny links
directions.study: GOV.UK Design System, U.S. Web Design System

directions.name: Editorial
directions.fits: blog magazine news journalism newsletter publication essay longform article story publisher podcast literature publishing
directions.motion: none beyond link and image hover
directions.imagery: strong photography or commissioned illustration with captions
directions.signature: a dramatic serif headline and a perfect reading column
directions.avoid: card grids for articles, tiny body text, sidebars that fight the story
directions.study: The Pudding, Stripe Press, The Atlantic

directions.name: Quiet luxury
directions.fits: luxury fashion jewelry beauty skincare cosmetics perfume boutique hotel architecture interior design atelier premium high end
directions.imagery: large, quiet product photography with lots of space
directions.signature: huge whitespace and one oversized serif line
directions.avoid: badges, discount banners, bright colors, crowded grids

directions.name: Playful consumer
directions.fits: social app consumer delivery food delivery dating community event tickets party music streaming quiz habit streak fun casual gen z
directions.feel: playful friendly energetic warm bold fun
directions.imagery: bright illustration or candid photos of real people
directions.signature: big rounded shapes and a celebration moment after the main action
directions.avoid: corporate blue, thin grey type, stiff stock photos

directions.name: Clean storefront
directions.fits: ecommerce e-commerce shop store retail marketplace product catalog cart checkout apparel shoes furniture homeware dtc brand
directions.shadow: none; product photos do the work
directions.motion: image hover zoom 1.02-1.03, fast cart feedback
directions.imagery: consistent product photography on matching backgrounds
directions.signature: big, consistent product imagery with price and add-to-cart always obvious
directions.avoid: carousels, fake urgency timers, pop-ups on arrival

directions.name: Warm hospitality
directions.fits: restaurant cafe coffee bakery bar recipe cooking food menu catering winery brewery hotel booking reservation grocery farm
directions.imagery: real, well-lit food and place photography
directions.signature: a menu-like typographic layout with real photos of the place
directions.avoid: stock food photos, cold blue, cramped menus as PDFs

directions.name: Studio portfolio
directions.fits: portfolio agency studio designer photographer artist creative architect personal site resume showcase case study
directions.motion: one authored moment: a page or image transition
directions.imagery: the work itself, very large
directions.signature: an unexpected layout or type treatment that shows a point of view
directions.avoid: template sections (services, testimonials, CTA) in the usual order
directions.study: Pentagram, Awwwards site of the day winners

directions.name: Data dense
directions.fits: dashboard analytics metrics monitoring observability logs admin reporting bi business intelligence charts kpi operations crm inventory logistics shipping shipment parcel tracking carrier dispatch fleet warehouse freight delivery route
directions.motion: none except loading and live-update hints
directions.imagery: charts only; a fixed, color-blind-safe chart palette
directions.signature: neutral chrome so the data colors are the only color on screen
directions.avoid: decorative color, 3D charts, pie charts with many slices

directions.name: Learning
directions.fits: education learning course school students teacher tutoring lms quiz exam language learning edtech university study flashcards
directions.imagery: friendly diagrams and simple illustration
directions.signature: visible progress and one learning step at a time
directions.avoid: walls of text, punishing red, cluttered navigation

directions.name: Conversational
directions.fits: ai assistant chatbot chat copilot llm agent writing assistant support bot messaging prompt generator
directions.motion: streaming text and subtle typing state; nothing flashy
directions.imagery: none; the conversation is the product
directions.signature: a comfortable reading width and a composer that feels like writing
directions.avoid: purple gradients, sparkle icons everywhere, robot mascots

directions.name: Developer docs
directions.fits: documentation docs api reference sdk developer portal guide tutorial changelog open source library framework readme
directions.imagery: code samples and simple diagrams
directions.signature: excellent code blocks with copy buttons and a sticky table of contents
directions.avoid: marketing hero on docs pages, hidden search, low-contrast code themes
directions.study: Stripe docs, Tailwind CSS docs, MDN

directions.name: Enterprise suite
directions.fits: enterprise erp crm hr human resources admin console internal tool back office procurement compliance workflow approvals ticketing helpdesk
directions.imagery: icons only
directions.signature: strong tables, filters, and bulk actions that save hours
directions.avoid: consumer flourishes, hidden actions, modals inside modals

directions.name: Natural
directions.fits: outdoor nature sustainability climate environment garden plants farming agriculture eco energy solar hiking camping conservation
directions.imagery: real landscapes and people outdoors; maps
directions.signature: earthy palette and honest numbers about impact
directions.avoid: neon green, greenwashing stock leaves, vague claims

directions.name: Travel and stay
directions.fits: travel booking book hotel vacation rental real estate property listing apartment airline trip tour destination map traveller tourist surf surfing diving ski resort camp
directions.imagery: large place photography and maps
directions.signature: photo-led listings with price, dates, and location always clear
directions.avoid: hidden fees, tiny photos, cluttered filters

directions.name: Hardware and tech
directions.fits: hardware device gadget electronics robotics iot audio synth camera drone space aerospace engineering lab deep tech
directions.imagery: product renders and technical drawings
directions.signature: a spec-sheet grid with monospaced labels and one signal color
directions.avoid: soft pastels, rounded blobs, generic 'futuristic' purple glow

directions.name: Community cause
directions.fits: nonprofit charity donation volunteer ngo foundation church community organization fundraising campaign advocacy
directions.imagery: real people from the community, with consent and dignity
directions.signature: a real story up front and one clear way to help
directions.avoid: pity imagery, many competing calls to action

directions.name: Professional services
directions.fits: law legal firm lawyer consulting accounting firm advisory architecture firm b2b services recruiting agency corporate
directions.imagery: real team photos and plain facts, no gavels or handshakes
directions.signature: confident serif headings and specific proof (cases, outcomes)
directions.avoid: stock photos of suits, vague 'solutions' language

directions.name: Game night
directions.fits: game gaming esports streaming entertainment movie film anime comics music festival nightlife fan tournament
directions.shadow: glow allowed on the accent only
directions.motion: can lead: 300ms transitions, hover energy, reduced-motion fallback
directions.imagery: key art and characters, full bleed
directions.signature: dark, full-bleed key art with a condensed display face
directions.avoid: corporate layouts, small imagery, too many neon colors at once

directions.name: Kids and family
directions.fits: kids children family parents baby toys preschool games for kids story stories picture books reading app school parents childcare
directions.imagery: friendly characters and big icons
directions.signature: huge touch targets and characters that guide each step
directions.avoid: small text, dark patterns, ads, anything that collects data from children

directions.name: Neo-brutal indie
directions.fits: indie maker creator newsletter zine side project tool for creators digital products gumroad link in bio hackathon art collective
directions.imagery: flat color blocks and stickers
directions.signature: thick black borders and hard shadows on a bright surface
directions.avoid: soft gradients and glass, mixing with corporate polish

directions.name: Wellness
directions.fits: wellness meditation yoga fitness sleep mindfulness spa self care nutrition coaching mental wellbeing journaling breathing
directions.motion: slow breathing rhythms 400-800ms, always with reduced-motion fallback
directions.imagery: soft natural photography, warm light
directions.signature: rounded calm surfaces and a single slow animated moment
directions.avoid: aggressive streaks, red alerts, crowded stats
